env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd w
logos run .
stdout '^static bound ok$'
stdout '^fallback bound ok$'
stdout '^mutual bound ok$'
stdout '^shallow ok$'

-- w/go.mod --
module example.com/depthbound

go 1.27

-- w/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"runtime/debug"
	"strings"
)

type N struct {
	Next *N? `json:"next"`
}

type MF struct {
	M    map[string]any `json:"m"`
	Next *MF?           `json:"next"`
}

type A struct {
	Next *B? `json:"next"`
}

type B struct {
	Next *A? `json:"next"`
}

func nest(open string, depth int) string {
	var b strings.Builder
	for range depth {
		b.WriteString(open)
	}
	b.WriteString(`null`)
	for range depth {
		b.WriteString(`}`)
	}
	return b.String()
}

func checkBound(name string, doc string, decode func([]byte) error) {
	if err := decode([]byte(doc)); err == nil {
		panic(name + " deep input decoded without a depth error")
	} else if !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "exceeded max depth") {
		panic(name + " want depth error, got " + err.Error())
	}
	fmt.Println(name + " bound ok")
}

func main() {
	debug.SetMaxStack(64 << 20)
	var n N
	checkBound("static", nest(`{"next":`, 20000), n.UnmarshalJSON)
	var mf MF
	checkBound("fallback", nest(`{"m":{},"next":`, 20000), mf.UnmarshalJSON)
	var m A
	checkBound("mutual", nest(`{"next":`, 20000), m.UnmarshalJSON)
	var s N
	if err := s.UnmarshalJSON([]byte(nest(`{"next":`, 500))); err != nil {
		panic("shallow valid input rejected: " + err.Error())
	}
	fmt.Println("shallow ok")
}
